subject.title: fix(telegram): DM lane stays dead after a wedged handler keeps it guarded; escalate to a supervised gateway restart

question: Should channel plugins publish a generic `ChannelAccountSnapshot.processRestartRequired` signal that core may translate into a whole-gateway restart, or should Telegram request this recovery through a narrower owner-specific seam?
rationale: Both designs can implement the fix, but this establishes a public plugin lifecycle contract and availability policy that code review cannot safely choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep the generic health signal
options.body: Approve the additive snapshot field as a reusable channel-health contract, with cooldown, budgeting, and restart policy remaining core-owned.

options.title: Use a Telegram-owned seam
options.body: Replace the public snapshot field with a narrow injected runtime request so other channel plugins do not gain a generic whole-gateway restart signal.

recommendation.title: Keep the generic health signal
recommendation.body: Approve the additive snapshot field as a reusable channel-health contract, with cooldown, budgeting, and restart policy remaining core-owned.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows sustained ownership of Telegram spool and polling recovery, and the PR discussion already asks this person to decide the boundary.
